issues.descricao: The resolver is passed only at the linkWithPopup call. If auth is built with initializeAuth and no popupRedirectResolver, any future popup or redirect call (signInWithPopup, linkWithRedirect) will hit the same error.
issues.sugestao: Consider setting popupRedirectResolver once where initializeAuth is called, so call sites don't each need it. This is optional; the fix is correct and limited to this feature.
